name: ax-problem-evidence-plugin
description: Augments a tax agent to proactively detect how a Korean VAT law amendment may destabilize existing enforcement standards and past rulings, producing an honestly-labeled internal review list.

interface.shortDescription: Proactive VAT amendment-impact detection: augments a tax agent to flag enforcement standards and past rulings a law change may destabilize.
interface.longDescription: Augments a tax agent for proactive impact detection: given a Korean VAT law/decree amendment, it prioritizes official enforcement standards and produces an honestly status-labeled review list (confirmed / REVIEW_WORTHY / hold_확인필요 / exclude); it never asserts a flip. The core rule-type sweep is validated (logic gate + funnel + blind backtest); a deep-judgment layer (applies the amendment's new 요건 to past 예규 fact patterns with 요건 원문 인용, counter-arguments, calibrated confidence, mandatory adversarial verification) and adjudication signal layers (L1 개정 / L2 심판례 / L3 판례) are designed and piloted (n=1), not yet statistically validated. Includes a company-problem-evidence skill that separates facts, assumptions, and missing information.
defaultPrompt: Use this plugin for my AX hackathon company problem and tax enforcement standard impact workflow.
